description: add-mole-parity-suite 15.1/15.2 real-device records of the Windows resident utilities (Windows 11 Enterprise 10.0.26200 x64, Lenovo laptop, elevated shell for powercfg). Commands are the ignored real-device tests in crates/cm-platform/src/windows/resident.rs and resident_screen.rs. No system setting was changed permanently: the only registry writes went to throwaway HKCU\Software\CleanManagerTest\<unique> keys, deleted by the tests.
base_commit_note: uncommitted working tree on top of this commit

records.api: SetThreadExecutionState(ES_CONTINUOUS | ES_DISPLAY_REQUIRED | ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED) on a dedicated thread; release = SetThreadExecutionState(ES_CONTINUOUS)
records.before: powercfg /requests: the test process listed under neither DISPLAY nor SYSTEM
records.during: powercfg /requests: [PROCESS] \Device\HarddiskVolume6\workplace\cleanmanager\target\debug\deps\cm_platform-9babf5e6266a0b21.exe listed under DISPLAY and SYSTEM
records.after: powercfg /requests: the process listed under neither section after release
records.duration_expiry: unit test keep_awake_holds_and_releases_on_its_own_thread: a 20 ms request is no longer active after 300 ms

records.window: found by class CleanManager.CleanScreen; rect (0, 0, 1440, 900) equals the virtual screen as seen by the (DPI-unaware) test process; WS_EX_TOPMOST set; visible
records.timeout_exit: timeout 3 s: exited with timeout after 3.08 s; input hooks removed (is_running false)
records.esc_exit: injected Esc down 0.5 s (ignored), then held 2.6 s: exited with esc_held after 3.52 s of a 30 s timeout
records.input: WH_KEYBOARD_LL swallows key presses (and the releases of swallowed presses), WH_MOUSE_LL swallows clicks and wheel; both removed before run() returns. Ctrl+Alt+Del cannot be intercepted and remains available.

records.source: HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\CapabilityAccessManager\ConsentStore\{webcam,microphone} (packaged apps and NonPackaged desktop apps), read-only; in use = LastUsedTimeStart != 0 and LastUsedTimeStop == 0
records.note: No app was using the camera or microphone during the snapshot. The appear/disappear behaviour (app named while in use, cleared after LastUsedTimeStop is set) is covered by consent_records_are_read_from_an_injected_root against a throwaway HKCU key; a live camera/microphone session was not started by the agent.

bluetooth.source: device property {104EA319-6EE2-4701-BD47-8DDBF425BBE5},2 (byte) read with SetupDiGetDevicePropertyW over present device nodes; it is the level the Windows Bluetooth stack records for devices that report one (shown in Settings > Bluetooth & devices). It is not declared in the public SDK headers, so devices without it are shown as not reporting, never estimated.
bluetooth.result: no paired Bluetooth device on this laptop; the page says so. A device that reports its level could not be tested here.

records.alerts: BatteryAlerts unit tests (cm-core): one alert below the threshold, none while still low or charging, re-armed after recovering by 5 points; alerts are checked only by the tray loop, which runs only while the tray is on

records.result: unit tests passed (not exercised on the real Run key)
tests: cm-core resident::tests::turning_off_stops_and_joins_the_sampling_loop (injected sampler counting ticks: no tick after turn_off)
records.post_check: HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run has no CleanManager.Resident value; HKCU\Software\CleanManagerTest removed; powercfg /requests lists no CleanManager process
